Stale packs raise StaleContextError. Unavailable packs raise UnavailableContextError. require_sufficient rejects expansion-required packs. existing_equivalents.finding: The bundle stores references to exact semantic, contract, abstract, proof, test, static, security, policy, and authority lineage. The verifier rebuilds content identities and compact checks and rejects forged CIDs, stale roots, missing mandatory evidence, producer flags, omitted compact checks, and lineage mismatch.
